title: Impact Racing
overview:
Your route to survival is to destroy anything that gets in the way.

- 12 challenging tracks with hairpin curves, gut wrenching jumps and high speed blasts.
- Each car has its own unique speed, handling, skidding, braking and gameplay tactics.
- Weapon power-ups include laser cannon double-up, heat seeking missiles, powerful land mines, awesome fire walls and the ultimate smart bomb.

So plug yourself into Impact Racing, get tooled up and dispense of your Road Rampage.
